en: An aerial color view of a small European town in a narrow green valley, surrounded by forested hills. The town has dense clusters of red‑tiled roofs, white houses, a visible church tower, and a railway line with tracks and a station running through the center. The surrounding landscape is composed of patchwork fields and meadows bordered by woods. There is no visible printed text on the image side.
